about: Round C's human table (bot v0.6.225, CHANGELOG): a human with a Grand Ball-heavy Toreador test deck against Hanna (tremere, the prey) and Viktor (nosferatu, the predator), Standard 3 s, no reflex. Run from the repository root: node client/playtest/playtest-rig.js --out <run dir> [--vtes <vtes.json> --offline], then node client/playtest/playtest.js setup bot/tools/playtest-ball/scenario.json. Turn 1: three Toreador into play; turn 2: play the Ball (aimed at the other of a pair, or not aimed), lock one, then the minion phase; the bots' 'memo:' console lines and the question; their hunts a round later.
